scope: Actual RegistryClient and install_from_registry handler with isolated loopback HTTP requests; no ordinary CLI argument dispatch, production registry, signed advisory authenticity, or AOT claim.
policy: Advisory HTTP failure, transport failure, malformed JSON or mismatched release identity returns an error before archive download and project dependency/lockfile updates. A valid empty report alone prints the clean message. A valid nonempty report preserves warnings and the existing continue-install policy.
test_accounting: 7 outer test entries: 4 existing routing/configuration controls, 2 matrices with 12 advisory cases each, and 1 subprocess entry which is inert in the parent. All pass on the fix.
baseline: The first attempt failed to compile the test because List has no range index. After correcting only the test iteration, the client and install matrices both failed at HTTP401: an empty report was synthesized, the clean message printed, archive downloaded, and manifest/lockfile updated. The fixed run completes every matrix case.
mutation_boundary: The install handler refuses unavailable data with original manifest bytes, absent new lockfile and absent package archive; the HTTP fixture confirms no download. CacheManager construction may create an empty directory before the handler.
artifact_boundary: Rust-only tests use pinned previously produced stdlib files with automatic baking disabled. Their unchanged hashes are recorded; this is not an ordinary compiler or stdlib runtime test.
ci: The tests are attached to cog.rs under cfg(test) and execute in the workspace lib/bins unit job.
raw_log_whitespace: fixed.log preserves the exact captured final blank line; only this raw log is excluded from the whitespace gate. All code, JSON and other raw logs pass.
